pins.head: MICA OR PIGMENT PASTE?
pins.title: Resin Color: Mica Powder, Pigment Paste or Alcohol Ink?
pins.desc: Mica powder gives a pearly shimmer, pigment paste blocks the light for solid color, and alcohol ink tints without adding body — but each one only behaves if your resin system lists it as compatible. Find the maximum the resin maker allows, measure the colorant on its own, and treat that number as a ceiling rather than a starting point. Test small labeled samples at the thickness you actually pour and judge them only after a full cure. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #MicaPowder #ResinCrafts
pins.alt: Three open jars of teal, copper and violet mica powder in a row on a dark slate work mat, a small white pigment tube beside them and clear cups of amber tinted resin to the right.

pins.head: FLAT PENDANT FIRST
pins.title: Resin Jewelry for Beginners: Start With One Flat Pendant
pins.desc: A flat pendant is the easiest first piece, because you can settle its shape, its hanging point and the chain it will sit on before any resin is mixed. Use one documented resin system, stay inside the maker's ratio and batch limits, and lay the inclusions out at actual size on paper first. Let it cure fully before sanding or drilling, then check the edge, the hole and the hardware the way a wearer would. Contains affiliate links. #ResinJewelry #DIYJewelry #HandmadeGifts
pins.alt: A clear silicone mold tray with oval and teardrop cavities on a linen cloth, two finished resin pendants with pressed flowers inside, a white dish of small gold jump rings and flat-nose pliers on a light oak table.

pins.head: LINE IT UP BEFORE IT STICKS
pins.title: Layered Vinyl Decals: Line the Colors Up Without Bubbles
pins.desc: A two-color decal is really an alignment job. Decide the layer order and whether the top color stacks or knocks out before you cut, then give yourself two widely spaced registration marks that never move. Set the base layer down first, line the second layer up to those marks before it touches anything, and lower it slowly from one edge so the trapped air has somewhere to go. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #DecalTips

pins.head: A LID IS ALSO A SEAT
pins.title: Small Living Room Storage That Does Not Crowd the Room
pins.desc: Storage only helps in a small living room if it stays out of the walking route. Keep the things you actually use in this room, give each one a return spot, and measure the path with people seated and lids or drawers open before you buy anything. A lidded ottoman earns its floor space twice because it is also a seat, and a basket on an open side table sorts the clutter without another cabinet. Contains affiliate links. #SmallSpaceLiving #LivingRoomStorage #ApartmentOrganization

pins.head: FINE TIPS DO THE DETAIL
pins.title: Fine Pointed Brushes Are What Make the Detail Pass Work
pins.desc: A worn or oversized brush turns a clean detail pass into a smudge. A set of fine pointed rounds in several sizes lets you keep one for crisp edges, one for eyes and small metal, and one you are willing to ruin on drybrushing. Rinse them before the paint sets and store them tip up — a cheap set treated well outlasts an expensive one left standing in water. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #PaintBrushes #AcrylicPainting
pins.alt: A row of slim round paint brushes with pale wooden handles and silver ferrules fanned across a dark grey desk mat above a white palette holding olive, ochre and blue paint.

pins.head: RULES BEFORE BOXES
pins.title: Dorm Room Storage That Fits the Housing Rules
pins.desc: Dorm rules are usually stricter than a lease, so read the housing handbook and the roommate agreement before you buy anything or move a single piece of furniture. Measure with the assigned furniture in place, use the closet and desk you already have for vertical storage instead of building towers, and pick containers you can carry, dry out and take home. Keep the doorway and anything electrical clear. Contains affiliate links. #DormRoom #CollegeDorm #SmallSpaceStorage
